themes_detail.label: Sudden Surge in Public Intoxication
themes_detail.summary: Drinking-related 311 complaints spiked to 13 THIS WEEK, up 700% from a 1.6-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.34), suggesting a sharp, concentrated emergence of public intoxication incidents in Morrisania/Crotona.
evidence: 13 drinking complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.6 per-week average over prior 8 weeks
700% spike with z-score of 9.34 (extremely statistically significant)
No prior Reddit or local news reporting on this issue in district
reporting_angles: Interview residents on specific blocks to identify concentration and triggers for this sudden surge
Contact NYPD and local precinct for context: new bars, venue closures, or enforcement changes that might explain timing

themes_detail.label: Homeless Assistance Calls Spike This Week
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints jumped to 5 THIS WEEK, up 700% from a 0.6-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 9.04), indicating either a sudden influx of homeless individuals or new visibility in the district.
evidence: 5 homeless assistance complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 per-week average over prior 8 weeks
700% spike with z-score of 9.04 (extremely statistically significant)
Convergence: panhandling also spiked to 3 complaints THIS WEEK (500% above baseline)
reporting_angles: Identify specific locations (parks, transit hubs, major intersections) where homeless individuals are concentrated this week
Interview local service providers, outreach teams, and shelter operators to understand whether this is new homelessness or existing population becoming more visible

themes_detail.label: Air Quality Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Air Quality complaints surged to 4 LAST WEEK, up 967% from a 0.4-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.21), suggesting localized pollution or air hazard concerns emerging in the district.
evidence: 4 air quality complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 per-week average over prior 8 weeks
967% spike with z-score of 5.21 (highly statistically significant)
259 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (170 alterations, 57 new buildings, 7 demolitions) — construction dust potential factor
reporting_angles: Cross-reference active construction sites and demolitions (7 in past 90 days) with air quality complaint locations
Check with NYC Department of Environmental Protection for any air quality monitoring data or emissions violations in the district

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs and Animal Hazards
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed Dog complaints jumped to 3 LAST WEEK, up 700% from a 0.4-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.42), and Unsanitary Animal conditions spiked to 6 TWO WEEKS AGO (586% above baseline), signaling emerging public safety and sanitation concerns tied to animal control.
evidence: 3 unleashed dog complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 per-week average over prior 8 weeks (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
6 unsanitary animal complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.9 per-week average (586% spike, z-score: 4.87)
Two related spikes suggest systemic animal control or enforcement issue
reporting_angles: Identify specific parks, playgrounds, or residential blocks where unleashed dogs and animal waste complaints are concentrated
Interview Parks Department and Animal Care & Control about staffing, enforcement capacity, and any enforcement changes in past 3 weeks

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Damaged Street Sign complaints jumped to 4 LAST WEEK (540% spike, z-score: 6.97) and Curb Condition complaints hit 3 TWO WEEKS AGO (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35), indicating acute street infrastructure damage across the district.
evidence: 4 street sign complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 per-week average (540% spike, z-score: 6.97)
3 curb condition complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 per-week average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
DOB: 259 permits filed in last 90 days (170 alterations, 57 new buildings) — potential construction damage to street furniture
reporting_angles: Photograph and map the specific locations of damaged signs and curbs to identify patterns (construction zone correlation, potholes, weather damage)
Contact Dept. of Transportation to inquire about recent construction, utility work, or weather-related damage and repair timelines
